name: Water Elemental
primary:
A water elemental appears in front of you and follows you for 60 s. At most 2 elementals serve you at once: a third one replaces the oldest. It attacks monsters nearby and whoever fights you, and never harms you or your allies.
Rolls after you as a living wave and throws water orbs every 1.3 s from up to 13 blocks:
• Damage 2 ❤ water
• Wet for 5 s
• Knocks back a little
self_description: The elemental appears right next to you.
